text.en: The main restaurant occupies Crown Hotel's ground floor in the old city center, opposite the Quince Martires Monument.
Hung ma is braised pork, traditionally paired here with hung ma bread.
Its Elias Angeles menu lists pork and beef siomai, spareribs dim sum and chicken feet.
Crown Park fried rice, pancit guisado and beef brisket with wonton also appear on its menu.
